title: Docs Reader Events
description: One submission per page view of the DocFX documentation site. Written by the beacon in tools/docs-analytics/main.js. Four fields on purpose: every field costs index/typed/field rows, so the shape is kept as small as it can be and still answer 'which page, how many people, where from'.

fields.label: Page path
fields.helpText: Pathname only — never the query string, which can carry personal data.

fields.label: Visitor key
fields.helpText: A random id the browser generates and keeps. Not an IP, not a fingerprint — and a bot that does not run JS never gets one, which is a better filter than a user-agent blocklist.

fields.label: Referrer
fields.helpText: Origin only, not the full referring URL.

fields.label: Event type
fields.helpText: view today; leaves room for search or download later without a second form.
